name: Bicheon
description: You will soar high into the sky mastering swords. This swordmanship is very moderate and powerful.

name: Heuksal
description: Heuksalchangbeop is the spearmanship of the heuksalmun. It is the result of a comprehensive survey of various spearmanships.

name: Pacheon
description: The Secret Archery is so powerful it breaks even the sky. The skill is very graceful and militant.

name: Cold
description: Hanbingmyeongong is a Force skill which uses the energy of ice. So you can freeze the enemy instantaneously and effectively.

name: Lightning
description: Pungroibigong is a Force skill which uses the energy of lightning. so you can give electric pain to the enemy.

name: Fire
description: Hwaryeongsingong is a Force skill which uses the energy of fire. So you can burn the enemy.

name: Force
description: Gihyeoldaebeop is not a killing skill to harm people. But a healing skill to save lives.

name: Warrior
description: The Warrior class is strong and effective for short-distance attacks based on their physical strength and power.It also wears heavy armor without any discomfort which enables them to demonstrate the stronger ability in physical attacks and defenses than any other classes do.

name: Wizard
description: Wizards understand the four basic elements of the world that are hidden in the nature: Earth, Water, Fire, and Air. They uses their knowledge to mix this power of the four elements to create strong magical attacks when they subdue the enemy.

name: Rogue
description: They balance the world by quietly terminating their opponents. They are experts at making surprise attacks from a long distance hiding itself in the dark and using dagger's dripped in poison to give the final blow.

name: Warlock
description: Warlocks are a dark class. They are known for placing curses on their enemies which literally tortures opponents till the end. These curses also gradually reduce the power of their enemies, eventually paralyze them and confuse them. They can use similar powers of the Wizard's to directly attack the enemies.

name: Bard
description: Bards assist party members and allies with music which produces various effects. The music that Bards play not only gives allies the self confidence that they can win against any enemies but also provides better abilities and strength. They have further deveolped these skills to confuse their enemies and hurt them. Through a musical performance an ensemble of Bards will give a group the power to defeat their enemies.

name: Cleric
description: Clerics borrow God's ability to cure others, free them from pain, and bless them with power so that they will have easier time defeating the enemies. The will to protect themselves from evil and resurrect allies is found within the Cleric.
